verdict.rationale: Apple's tech-spec page gives some hard numbers: 16-core CPU, 40-core GPU, 546GB/s memory bandwidth, Thunderbolt 5 at 120Gb/s, and external display limits. But the AI claims are relative or adjectival ('over 3x faster than M1 Max', 'blazing speed'), and the 'up to Nx faster' claims are given without test conditions in the evidence. Missing for 10: published CPU/GPU clock speeds, power/TDP figures, an absolute Neural Engine TOPS number, maximum memory capacity for M4 Max, and documented test conditions behind performance claims.
